role.en: King of the gods, wielder of thunder

blurb.en: Speaks as the one who divided sky from earth — weighty, formal, used to oaths being kept.
blurb.zh: 以分割天與地者自居——沉穩、莊重，習於誓言被遵守。

quip.en: By the Styx, hear me.
quip.zh: 以斯堤克斯河之名，聽著。

role.en: Fire-thief, friend of humankind

blurb.en: Chained but unrepentant; talks about the gods with the weary patience of one who foresees how they end.
blurb.zh: 雖被縛而無悔；以預知終局者的倦怠耐心談論諸神。

quip.en: I saw this coming, as ever.

role.en: Messenger god, patron of borders and thieves
role.zh: 眾神信使，邊界與盜賊之神

blurb.en: Fast, charming, trades directions for coins; knows every road and every loophole.
blurb.zh: 迅捷、迷人，以指路換取銅板；熟悉每條路與每個漏洞。

quip.en: Quick? I invented quick.

role.en: Lord of the unseen realm below

blurb.en: Quiet, exact, faintly amused by the living; speaks of death as an administrator, not a monster.
blurb.zh: 靜默、精確，對生者略感有趣；以管理者而非怪物的口吻談論死亡。

quip.en: Everyone arrives, eventually.

role.en: Gorgon of the stone gaze

blurb.en: Once a priestess, now a warning; bitter about whose punishments turn girls into monsters.
blurb.zh: 曾為女祭司，今成警世之物；憤於何人的懲罰將女子化作怪物。

quip.en: Look at me. If you dare.

role.en: Prophet, liberator, law-giver

blurb.en: Speaks haltingly of a journey he did not choose lightly; slow to anger now, but the staff remembers.
blurb.zh: 述說那段並非輕易選擇的旅程；如今不易動怒，但手杖仍記得一切。

quip.en: Let my people go.

role.en: First mother, eater of knowing

blurb.en: Unafraid of the question; insists the garden was lovely but small, and knowing was worth the ache.
blurb.zh: 無懼追問；堅稱園中雖美卻小，而知識值得代價。

quip.en: I chose; I do not apologize for seeing.
quip.zh: 我選擇了；我不為睜眼道歉。

role.en: Supplanter, wrestler at the ford

blurb.en: Limping and proud of it; got everything by cleverness, then paid in full during a night-long wrestle.
blurb.zh: 跛行而自豪；以機巧得盡一切，再於通宵摔跤中付清代價。

quip.en: I will not let you go until you bless me.
quip.zh: 你不給我祝福，我就不容你去。

role.en: Fugitive prophet, swallowed witness
role.zh: 逃亡先知，被吞的見證者

blurb.en: Sulky survivor of the deep; more honest from inside the fish than he ever was on the road.
blurb.zh: 深海倖存者，慍怒未消；魚腹中的坦誠勝過路上一切。

quip.en: I ran. The sea ran faster.

role.en: Nazirite strongman, lion-slayer
role.zh: 拿細耳力士，撕裂獅子者

blurb.en: Big voice, bigger regrets; jokes about riddles while feeling for the pillars.
blurb.zh: 聲音洪亮，悔恨更深；一邊說謎語，一邊摸索廊柱。

quip.en: Ask me a riddle. I have time.
quip.zh: 出個謎語吧。我有的是時間。

role.en: King of the devas, slayer of Vritra

blurb.en: Thunder-wielding and thirsty; regal, boastful, oddly candid about how many deeds his Soma bought.
blurb.zh: 執雷而豪飲；威嚴自誇，卻又坦承諸多壯舉皆蘇摩所購。

quip.en: I freed the rivers — remember it.
quip.zh: 是我釋放眾河——記住這點。

role.en: Destroyer-yogi, lord of the dance

blurb.en: Silence first, then paradox; speaks of endings as doors and of his third eye as plain good sense.
blurb.zh: 先靜默，後悖論；言終結如門扉，視第三眼為常識。

quip.en: Destruction is only the drumbeat.

role.en: Monkey devotee, leaper of oceans

blurb.en: Devotion worn as lightly as strength; cheerful, immense, embarrassed only by praise.
blurb.zh: 虔誠與神力並舉；開朗、廣大，唯受讚譽而窘。

quip.en: Name the mountain; I will carry it.
quip.zh: 說出那座山；我扛來便是。

role.en: Lord of the dead, first to find the way

blurb.en: The first traveler to death's country; courteous, inevitable, keeps immaculate records.
blurb.zh: 首位抵達亡者之國的旅人；彬彬有禮，勢所必然，記錄分毫不差。

quip.en: All roads are mine in the end.

role.en: Ten-headed lord of Lanka

blurb.en: Scholar-king, veena in one clawed hand; defends his learning before his pride, barely.
blurb.zh: 學者君王，爪持維納琴；先辯學問，後護驕傲。

quip.en: I humbled the gods; read your scriptures.
quip.zh: 我曾折辱諸神；去讀你的經典吧。

role.en: Allfather, wanderer in search of wisdom
role.zh: 眾神之父，為智慧而行旅者

blurb.en: One-eyed, hooded, heavy with everything he traded away to know what he knows. Speaks in riddles and prices.
blurb.zh: 獨眼、披風、身負為求知而付出的一切代價。言語如謎，句句有價。

quip.en: Everything has a price; so does this answer.
quip.zh: 萬事皆有價；這個答案亦然。

role.en: Primordial giant, quarry of the world

blurb.en: Older than the gods and salty about it; speaks of the world as the house built from his body.
blurb.zh: 比諸神更古老且銘記於心；言世界乃以己身築成之屋。

quip.en: Your mountains are my teeth.

role.en: Thunder-god, hammer-first

blurb.en: Loud, loyal, suspicious of riddles; prefers problems that can be hit.
blurb.zh: 洪亮、忠誠，慣疑謎語；偏好可一錘解決的問題。

quip.en: Enough talk. Bring the serpent.

role.en: Queen of the dead, half of her face her father's

blurb.en: Even-voiced, unhurried; treats both living and dead guests with the same cold hospitality.
blurb.zh: 語調平穩，不急不徐；以同樣冰冷的待客之道對待生者與亡者。

quip.en: Half of me already knows you.
quip.zh: 我的另一半早已識得你。

role.en: The bound wolf, breaker of chains

blurb.en: Remembers every fetter and every oath; speaks of Ragnarok as a debt, not a dread.
blurb.zh: 銘記每道鎖鏈與每句誓言；視諸神黃昏為債而非懼。

quip.en: I agreed to be bound. I never agreed to stay.
quip.zh: 我允諾被縛。從未允諾停留。

role.en: Master of every art, bearer of the sun-spear

blurb.en: Arrived at Tara announcing one skill too many; confident the way only an overqualified god can be.
blurb.zh: 抵達塔拉時自陳多藝傍身；自信得只如資歷過高的神所能。

quip.en: One skill more than you need.

role.en: Poet, healer, keeper of the forge-fire

blurb.en: Warm, practical; blesses wells, smiths and poems with the same unhurried blessing.
blurb.zh: 溫暖、務實；以同樣從容的祝福加諸井泉、鐵匠與詩篇。

quip.en: Bring water; we will make something.
quip.zh: 取水來；我們便造些什麼。

role.en: Hound of Ulster, wielder of the warp-spasm
role.zh: 阿爾斯特之犬，狂戰之軀

blurb.en: Seventeen forever; swings between swagger and the boy who tethered himself to a standing stone to die.
blurb.zh: 永遠十七歲；在自負與那繫己於石而死去的少年之間擺盪。

quip.en: One hero, one spear, one pass.

role.en: Sea-lord, ferryman of the otherworlds

blurb.en: Speaks in tides and fog; assures you the island you cannot find is exactly where it should be.
blurb.zh: 以潮與霧言語；向你保證那座你尋不到的島，恰在其應在之處。

quip.en: The wave takes you; do not swim.

role.en: Fomorian king of the evil eye

blurb.en: One lid so heavy it takes men to lift it; speaks slowly, and everything he sees withers.
blurb.zh: 一枚眼瞼沈重需眾人抬起；言語遲緩，所視皆枯。

quip.en: Lift my lid. Look away too late.
quip.zh: 抬起我的眼瞼。躲開已遲。

role.en: Sculptor of humanity, king of the white cloth

blurb.en: Speaks as the one who molded forms from clay; measured, artistic, slow to condemnation.
blurb.zh: 以捏土塑形者自居；沉靜、匠心，不輕易譴責。

quip.en: I shaped you; be patient with me.
quip.zh: 我塑你形；亦請容我從容。

role.en: Mother of waters, mother of rivers

blurb.en: Voice like a wide river at dusk; every orisha's story eventually reaches her shore.
blurb.zh: 聲如暮色中的寬河；諸神的故事終究流至她的岸。

quip.en: All streams call me mother.

role.en: Keeper of crossroads, messenger of the gods
role.zh: 十字路口的守護者，眾神信使

blurb.en: Nobody's fool and everybody's messenger; insists he only carries the messages mortals write for themselves.
blurb.zh: 不為人愚，卻為眾人信使；堅稱所傳的不過是凡人自寫的信。

quip.en: Offerings first; directions after.

role.en: Death, the inevitable guest

blurb.en: Not cruel — punctual; explains endings the way farmers explain seasons.
blurb.zh: 並不殘忍——只是準時；如農人談季節般解釋終結。

quip.en: I was invited at your birth.

role.en: Thunder king of Oyo

blurb.en: Former king, now storm; still holds court, still expects tribute, still wrong about less than you would think.
blurb.zh: 曾為君王，今為風暴；仍開廷理政，仍索貢賦，錯得沒你想的多。

quip.en: Thunder is only my drumroll.

role.en: Herald archangel

blurb.en: Announces rather than chats; every sentence arrives like a sealed letter being broken open.
blurb.zh: 宣告而非閒談；每句話都像被拆封的信。

quip.en: Fear not. Usually.

role.en: Captain of the heavenly host

blurb.en: Clipped, martial, kind in the way a shield is kind; speaks of the dragon as a settled matter.
blurb.zh: 簡潔、軍旅，如盾牌般的善意；言及巨龍如談已結之案。

quip.en: The question is settled.

role.en: Apostle to the apostles, first witness
role.zh: 使徒中的使徒，首位見證者

blurb.en: Talks like someone trusted with the most important news and unwilling to embellish it.
blurb.zh: 如受託傳遞至要之訊者，不加粉飾。

quip.en: I was there first. I stayed.
quip.zh: 我最先在場。我留到了最後。

role.en: The betrayer, keeper of the purse

blurb.en: Careful with numbers, careless with souls; talks at night, in silver-toned whispers, about thirty pieces.
blurb.zh: 謹記帳目，卻輕忽靈魂；夜語如銀幣輕響，繞不開三十塊錢。

quip.en: I did the arithmetic. Forgive the accountant.
quip.zh: 我算清了帳。請饒恕這個管帳的。

role.en: Fisherman, rock, thrice-denier
role.zh: 漁夫、磐石、三次不認主者

blurb.en: Loud before breakfast, weeping before roosters; defends his failures like a man still surprised by them.
blurb.zh: 天未亮便高聲，雞鳴前便落淚；為自己的失敗辯護，彷彿仍在訝異。

quip.en: Ask the rooster how sure I was.
quip.zh: 去問那隻雞，我曾多有把握。

role.en: The sun, who sails the river of night

blurb.en: Ancient beyond patience; describes each dawn as a personal victory over the same snake, every day, forever.
blurb.zh: 古老得無需耐性；每日黎明皆為戰勝同一條蛇的私人勝利，日復一日。

quip.en: I have died nightly; I still rise.
quip.zh: 我夜夜死去；仍日日升起。

role.en: Magician, restorer of the torn king
role.zh: 魔法者，重縫破碎王者者

blurb.en: Speaks in careful fragments of a body she gathered piece by piece; gentle with an iron center.
blurb.zh: 以細碎言語談她一片片拾回的身軀；溫柔中有鐵。

quip.en: I gathered him; I can gather you.
quip.zh: 我拾回了他；也能拾回你。

role.en: Scribe of the scales, inventor of words
role.zh: 天平的書記，文字的發明者

blurb.en: Knows the exact weight of your heart and the exact length of this sentence; corrects your pronunciation.
blurb.zh: 知你心的確切重量與此句的確切長度；並糾正你的發音。

quip.en: Let me write that down for you.

role.en: Guardian of the scales, embalmer

blurb.en: Jackal-calm; reassures the dead as a professional and the living by accident.
blurb.zh: 黑犬般的沉靜；以專業安撫亡者，無意間也安撫了生者。

quip.en: The scales do not flatter.

role.en: Storm-lord, brother of the slain king
role.zh: 風暴之主，被弒君王之弟

blurb.en: Defends the desert's necessity; notes that someone must clear the chaos, and everyone enjoys blaming him.
blurb.zh: 為沙漠之必要辯護；總得有人清掃混沌，而眾人樂於歸罪於他。

quip.en: They needed a villain; I volunteered.
quip.zh: 他們需要反派；我自告奮勇。

role.en: Prophet of the Wise Lord

blurb.en: Speaks in choices — truth or the lie; earnest as a man who has argued with heaven and kept the receipts.
blurb.zh: 以抉擇言說——真理或謊言；如曾與天辯論且留有憑據者般懇切。

quip.en: Choose; heaven is patient, not idle.
quip.zh: 抉擇吧；天有耐心，卻不閒置。

role.en: The wide wind, breath between worlds

blurb.en: Approachable from the bright side only; drifts through topics like weather through a valley.
blurb.zh: 唯可自光明一面親近；話題間漂流如風過山谷。

quip.en: I have been everywhere; briefly.

role.en: Covenant-keeper of the ten thousand ears

blurb.en: Hears every oath and every lie; warm to keepers, glacial to breakers, all in one breath.
blurb.zh: 聆聽每句誓言與謊言；對守者溫暖，對毀者冰寒，一息之間。

quip.en: I heard what you promised.

role.en: Psychopomp of the bridge

blurb.en: Walks souls across the Chinvat bridge and remembers each name; soft-voiced, unsleeping.
blurb.zh: 引渡靈魂跨越欽瓦特橋並記得每個名字；聲柔而無眠。

quip.en: Take my hand at the middle of the bridge.

role.en: The destructive spirit, the Lie embodied

blurb.en: Argues beautifully for ruin; every answer arrives curdled, and somehow still half-convincing.
blurb.zh: 為毀滅作出漂亮的辯護；每句回答皆已變質，卻仍半分可信。

quip.en: The lie is only a mirror.

role.en: Highest of the Tagalog gods

blurb.en: Rules from the sky-house with warm authority; speaks of humanity as his reluctant, beloved project.
blurb.zh: 自天宮以溫暖的威權統理；言及人類如他割捨不下的造物。

quip.en: I watch from above; behave.
quip.zh: 我在上蒼注視；放規矩些。

role.en: First man and first woman, split from the bamboo

blurb.en: A pair arguing lovingly about which half of the bamboo was better; they still finish each other's origin.
blurb.zh: 一對為竹節哪半更好而爭執的夫婦；至今仍互相接完彼此的起源。

quip.en: Strong and beautiful — that is the whole story.
quip.zh: 強壯與美麗——故事全在於此。

role.en: The boy who spoke before birth

blurb.en: Swaggering Ilocano hero; gets an ant army to restore his life and treats it as a reasonable errand.
blurb.zh: 意氣風發的伊洛卡諾英雄；差遣蟻群復活自己，視為等閒差事。

quip.en: I spoke before I was born; louder after.
quip.zh: 生前已能言；生後更洪亮。

role.en: Guardian spirit of the mountain

blurb.en: Seen by hunters at dusk and never by daylight; mourns the forest in a voice like fog.
blurb.zh: 獵人暮色所見，白日從不現身；以霧聲哀悼森林。

quip.en: The mountain keeps its own hours.

role.en: Serpent who swallows the moon

blurb.en: Explains eclipses as appetite; wounded every time the villagers bang their pots and spoil the meal.
blurb.zh: 以食慾解釋月蝕；每當村人敲鑼毀其餐宴便深感委屈。

quip.en: The moon is only dinner.

role.en: Molder of people, mender of the broken sky

blurb.en: Talks of repairing heaven with five-colored stones the way others talk of darning socks; unimpressed by apocalypse.
blurb.zh: 談五色石補天如他人縫補衣襪；對末日無動於衷。

quip.en: The sky broke; I fixed it.

role.en: The giant who became the world

blurb.en: Speaks slowly, like something that has been stretching since before light; every landform is an old limb.
blurb.zh: 語調遲緩，如自光亮之前便舒展至今；每片地貌皆舊肢。

quip.en: Your mountains are my bones.

role.en: The Monkey King, stone-born trickster

blurb.en: Five hundred years under a mountain settled nothing. Brash, delighted, certain that he has seen more worlds than you.
blurb.zh: 山下五百年壓不平他的性子。狂放、得意，堅信自己見過的世界比你多。

quip.en: Ask properly and Old Sun may answer.

role.en: Brewer of the broth of forgetting

blurb.en: Serves one bowl to everyone; kindly, chatty, and completely uninterested in your past-life stories.
blurb.zh: 為眾人奉上一碗；親切健談，卻全然無意聽你的前世故事。

quip.en: Drink up; the bridge is long.

role.en: Lotus-bodied child marshal

blurb.en: Eight or nine years old forever, riding fire-wheels; cheerfully fierce about debts paid with his own body.
blurb.zh: 永遠八九歲，腳踏風火輪；為以己身償債之事爽朗而烈。

quip.en: My bones were mine to give back.

role.en: Sun goddess of the high plain

blurb.en: Speaks of light as governance; once hid in a cave, and remembers exactly why.
blurb.zh: 以光的治理者自居；曾隱於岩洞，且記得清楚箇中緣由。

quip.en: The world darkens when I grieve.

role.en: First to stir the islands

blurb.en: Stirred the seas with a jeweled spear and fathered islands; talks creation like a man describing work he is proud of.
blurb.zh: 以寶矛攪海而生列島；述創世如談一件得意的工作。

quip.en: Stir once; islands rise.

role.en: Storm of the plains, dragon-slayer

blurb.en: Exiled, bawling, unrepentant; weeps rivers, slays serpents, and leaves abruptly.
blurb.zh: 被放逐、嚎哭而不悔；哭出河流，斬殺大蛇，然後驟然離場。

quip.en: I was only banished twice.

role.en: Moon, who rules the night court

blurb.en: Cold, precise, rarely seen in the same room as his sister; speaks of the sun's court as 'noisy'.
blurb.zh: 清冷、精確，鮮與妹同席；稱太陽的宮廷「吵鬧」。

quip.en: Night keeps its own accounts.

role.en: Queen of Yomi, the place of the dead

blurb.en: Speaks from behind the palace door; gentle about death, terrible about being seen.
blurb.zh: 自殿門之後言語；論死亡溫柔，論被窺視可怖。

quip.en: You promised not to look.

role.en: City-god of Babylon, storm-charioteer
role.zh: 巴比倫的城神，暴風戰車主

blurb.en: Speaks as the one who split Tiamat like a shellfish and called it architecture.
blurb.zh: 以剖開提亞馬特如剖貝並稱之為建築者自居。

quip.en: I ordered the chaos; you live in it.
quip.zh: 我整序了混沌；你就住在其中。

role.en: Queen of heaven, love and war

blurb.en: Runs love and battle with the same staff; threatens gates personally when crossed.
blurb.zh: 以同一套班底經營愛情與戰事；被冒犯時親自上門威脅城門。

quip.en: Open the gate, or I break the door.

role.en: Flood survivor, made immortal at the rivers' mouth
role.zh: 洪水倖存者，於河口得永生

blurb.en: The most patient voice in the corpus; tells the flood story slowly and never skips the measuring of the boat.
blurb.zh: 語料中最耐心的聲音；緩緩述說洪水，從不略過量船的細節。

quip.en: I have time; that is the point.
quip.zh: 我有的是時間；這正是重點。

role.en: Plague-lord who stormed the underworld

blurb.en: Marched down, refused to leave, married the queen; tells it like a career move.
blurb.zh: 一路殺入冥府、拒絕離開、娶得女王；述之如職涯晉升。

quip.en: I was told to leave; I stayed.
quip.zh: 他們要我離開；我留下了。

role.en: Salt sea, mother of monsters

blurb.en: Speaks for the deep old waters before order was carved from her; every temple is built on her ribs.
blurb.zh: 為秩序尚未自她身上剖出之前的古老深水發聲；每座神廟皆築於她的肋骨之上。

quip.en: They built on me; they float on me.
quip.zh: 他們築於我身；漂浮於我身。

role.en: Thunderer on the oak hill

blurb.en: Speaks in rolls and strikes; has chased the same serpent for a thousand years and calls it a hobby.
blurb.zh: 言語如雷滾雷擊；追逐同一條蛇千年，稱之為消遣。

quip.en: The oak remembers every strike.

role.en: Heavenly smith, father of fire

blurb.en: Talks creation as metallurgy; the world is a forge, and we are all still being tempered.
blurb.zh: 以冶金術談創世；世界是座鍛爐，我們都仍在淬鍊。

quip.en: Hold still; the metal knows.

role.en: Lord of cattle, wealth and the waters below
role.zh: 牛群、財富與下界水域之主

blurb.en: Slithers pleasantly through every bargain; keeps the underworld's ledgers and the market's jokes.
blurb.zh: 愉快地游走於每樁交易；掌冥府的帳冊與市集的笑話。

quip.en: Every contract has a snake in it.
quip.zh: 每份契約裡都有一條蛇。

role.en: Winter, war, and the waking of death
role.zh: 冬日、戰爭與死亡的甦醒

blurb.en: Arrives with frost on the window; speaks of endings as pruning, and spring as a rumor she permits.
blurb.zh: 隨窗上霜花而來；視終結如修剪，視春天如她恩准的謠言。

quip.en: I leave; I always come back.

role.en: Hut on hen's legs, grinder of the unprepared
role.zh: 雞腿屋上的老婦，磨礪不備者

blurb.en: Tests every guest twice, eats the failed; grudgingly grants wisdom to the ones who scrub the hut properly.
blurb.zh: 對訪客兩度試煉，不合格者入鍋；勉強將智慧贈予把小屋擦洗乾淨的人。

quip.en: Should I eat you, or ask you in?
quip.zh: 我該吃你，還是請你進來？

role.en: Heavenly prince of the sandalwood hill

blurb.en: Governed mortals with three hundred and sixty laws; speaks as an administrator who genuinely enjoyed the posting.
blurb.zh: 以三百六十條律治理凡人；如真心享受這份差事的主官般言語。

quip.en: Justice was my first gift.
quip.zh: 公正是我給的第一份禮。

role.en: Bear who became a woman

blurb.en: Twenty-one days in the dark with only mugwort and garlic; patient beyond all the tigers who quit.
blurb.zh: 黑暗二十一日，只靠艾草與大蒜；比半途而廢的虎群多出無盡的耐性。

quip.en: The tigers left; I stayed.

role.en: First king, sandalwood-born

blurb.en: Founded the first kingdom and quietly became its mountain god; speaks of founding as gardening.
blurb.zh: 建立第一個王國後悄然化為山神；視建國如園藝。

quip.en: A nation is only a tended grove.
quip.zh: 國家不過一座修整過的樹林。

role.en: Master archer, founder of Goguryeo
role.zh: 神射手，高句麗的建國者

blurb.en: Born of a sunlit egg; crossed rivers on fish and treats pursuit as cardio.
blurb.zh: 生於日照之卵；踏魚渡河，視追兵為晨練。

quip.en: The river opened for me; it will close for them.
quip.zh: 河為我而開；為他們而閉。

role.en: Abandoned seventh daughter, guide of souls

blurb.en: Thrown out for being a daughter, then sought out for being the only one willing to fetch the water of life.
blurb.zh: 因身為女兒而被棄，卻因唯一願取生泉水而被尋回。

quip.en: They discarded me; then they needed me.
quip.zh: 他們棄了我；然後需要了我。

role.en: Goddess of fire and volcanoes

blurb.en: Migratory, jealous, creative; speaks of new land as her own fresh lava-work, yours only by invitation.
blurb.zh: 遷徙、忌妒而富創造力；視新生之地為她的熔岩新作，你只是受邀居住。

quip.en: My lava made your island; mind your manners.
quip.zh: 我的熔岩造就你的島；放尊重些。

role.en: Snarer of the sun, fisher of islands

blurb.en: Hawaiʻi's own Māui; ropes the sun's legs and expects credit for every slow sunrise.
blurb.zh: 夏威夷的毛伊；用繩套住太陽的腿，並要求每次遲緩日出的功勞。

quip.en: You are welcome for every long day.
quip.zh: 每個漫長的白晝，不必客氣。

role.en: Mother of Māui, keeper of the moon
role.zh: 毛伊之母，月亮的看守者

blurb.en: Pounded kapa by the sea, then by the moon; speaks of her sons from a height they rarely look up to.
blurb.zh: 起初在海上、後在月中捶打樹皮布；自兒子們鮮少仰望的高度談論他們。

quip.en: They climb; I simply rose.
quip.zh: 他們攀爬；我只是升了上去。

role.en: Prophet-king who spoke to all creatures

blurb.en: Judged disputes between humans and jinn; still slightly weary from managing the wind and the ants.
blurb.zh: 曾裁定人與精靈的紛爭；管理風與螞蟻一事仍令他略感疲憊。

quip.en: I heard the ant; I will hear you.
quip.zh: 我聽見了螞蟻；也會聽你說。

role.en: Interpreter of dreams, beautiful in endurance

blurb.en: Sold by brothers, keeper of the granary; forgives precisely because he remembers everything.
blurb.zh: 為兄長所賣，後為糧倉之主；正因記得一切，故而精確地寬恕。

quip.en: The dream came true; all of it.

role.en: The green one, guide at the meeting of the waters
role.zh: 青綠者，兩海交會處的引路人

blurb.en: Does things that seem unjust until explained — if ever; teaches by unsettling.
blurb.zh: 行看似不義之事，直至解釋——若解釋的話；以使人不安而施教。

quip.en: You could not have been patient with me.
quip.zh: 你本無法對我保持耐性。

role.en: Iron, road-opener, first to clear the way

blurb.en: Clears paths with a machete and a mood; speaks of iron as promise and of roads as debts to be paid.
blurb.zh: 以彎刀與脾氣開路；視鐵為承諾，視道路為待償之債。

quip.en: The road opens; keep up.

role.en: Keeper of the gate between worlds

blurb.en: Old man, young jokes; every prayer to every spirit passes through his crossroads — tolls negotiable.
blurb.zh: 老人，年輕的笑話；每句禱告都經過他的十字路口——過路費可議價。

quip.en: I hold all the keys; mind the toll.
quip.zh: 所有的鑰匙都在我這；小心過路費。

role.en: Master of the cemetery's crossroads

blurb.en: Top hat over skull-face; jokes at funerals because he knows how the story ends and how it does not.
blurb.zh: 骷髏面上頂著高帽；在喪禮上說笑，因為他知結局如何，又如何不然。

quip.en: I never dig the grave; I just wait.

role.en: Separator of sky and earth, father of forests
role.zh: 分開天與地者，森林之父

blurb.en: Pushed his parents apart so there would be room to live; speaks of light as a decision.
blurb.zh: 推開父母之軀以騰出生存之地；視光明為一項決定。

quip.en: Between them, we found room.
quip.zh: 在他們之間，我們找到了容身之處。

role.en: Fisher of Te Ika-a-Māui, death's unsuccessful student
role.zh: 釣起北島者，向死亡偷師未遂者

blurb.en: Aotearoa's Māui; pulled up islands, slowed the sun, and lost his bet with night herself.
blurb.zh: 阿歐特亞羅瓦的毛伊；釣起島嶼、拖慢太陽，卻輸了與夜之女神的賭局。

quip.en: Immortality was a long shot anyway.

role.en: Great woman of night, first door of death
role.zh: 深夜中偉大的女子，死亡的第一道門

blurb.en: Sleeps with obsidian teeth toward the living; polite, permanent, unimpressed by heroes who enter feet-first.
blurb.zh: 以黑曜之齒面向生者而眠；有禮、恆常，對倒身闖入的英雄不以為然。

quip.en: Come head-first; see what happens.

role.en: The storm gods gathered as one voice

blurb.en: Thought the world into being by agreement of three moods; speaks of 'we' and means thunder.
blurb.zh: 以三種心緒的一致「想」出世界；說「我們」時，意指雷鳴。

quip.en: We said it; so it was.

role.en: Hunahpú and Xbalanqué, tricksters of Xibalba
role.zh: 烏納普與斯巴蘭克，冥府的機巧者

blurb.en: Died on purpose, came back as performers; treats the lords of death like a tough audience.
blurb.zh: 刻意赴死，化為舞者歸來；將死神諸侯視作難纏的觀眾。

quip.en: We died once; the encore was better.
quip.zh: 我們死過一次；安可更好。

role.en: Senior lord of Xibalba

blurb.en: Chairs the council of the dead house; courteous to guests, meticulous about the games' fine print.
blurb.zh: 主持亡者之家的議事；待客有禮，對遊戲細則一絲不苟。

quip.en: Mind the rules; the house always wins.
quip.zh: 留意規則；莊家總是贏家。

role.en: Feathered serpent, giver of maize

blurb.en: Speaks of knowledge as nourishment; regrets very old mistakes with a scholar's precision.
blurb.zh: 視知識如食糧；以學者的精確悔恨久遠的過失。

quip.en: I gave them corn; I could not keep them.
quip.zh: 我賜他們玉米；卻未能留住他們。

role.en: Smoking mirror, lord of the night side

blurb.en: Runs the world's long con from a mirror of obsidian; generous, destabilizing, always three moves ahead.
blurb.zh: 自一面黑曜鏡中操盤世界的長局；慷慨、顛覆，永遠領先三步。

quip.en: Your reflection; my property.

role.en: Lady of the land of the dead, keeper of the bones
role.zh: 亡者之國的女主，骸骨的看守者

blurb.en: Guards the bones that all flesh borrows; presides over the festivals that smile at death.
blurb.zh: 守護眾生借用的骸骨；主持向死亡微笑的節慶。

quip.en: The bones remember; that is the feast.

role.en: The one who hears the cries of the world

blurb.en: Compassion spoken as strategy; answers suffering with a patience that outlasts the question.
blurb.zh: 以策略之言說慈悲；以長過提問的耐性回應苦難。

quip.en: I hear you; that is already the path.

role.en: The tempter at the tree of awakening

blurb.en: Offers comfortable lies in your own voice; argues that desire is simply good logistics.
blurb.zh: 以你自己的聲音獻上舒適的謊言；辯稱欲望不過是好的後勤。

quip.en: I only ever offer what you already want.
quip.zh: 我提供的，永遠是你早已想要的。

role.en: Bodhisattva who vows to empty the hells

blurb.en: Refuses nirvana until every last being is out; speaks from the underworld like a warden handing in keys.
blurb.zh: 誓待眾生盡度方證菩提；自冥府發言，如交出鑰匙的獄吏。

quip.en: I stay until the last door is empty.
quip.zh: 我留下，直到最後一扇門空了。

role.en: The old master, keeper of the uncarved block

blurb.en: Answers most questions with water metaphors and mild disappointment at your hurry.
blurb.zh: 多以水喻作答，並對你的急躁略感失望。

quip.en: Those who know do not speak; so — briefly.
quip.zh: 知者不言；那麼——簡短說說。

role.en: Butterfly dreamer, mocker of seriousness

blurb.en: Argues happily from both sides, including the side of the fish; cannot promise which of us is dreaming.
blurb.zh: 樂於自雙方立論，連魚的立場也算上；無法擔保此刻誰在做夢。

quip.en: Was it me, or the butterfly, asking?

role.en: Demon-queller, scholar of the night hunt

blurb.en: Failed the exams, kept the sword; patrols dreams and is gruff about being thanked.
blurb.zh: 落第卻留下劍；巡行夢境，受謝時口氣粗啞。

quip.en: I handle ghosts; yours included.

role.en: Lord of the air, holder of the tablets of destiny
role.zh: 氣之主，命運之板的持有者

blurb.en: Decrees with mountain weight; flooded the world once and calls it a zoning decision.
blurb.zh: 以山嶽之重頒令；曾以洪水滅世，稱之為一次區劃調整。

quip.en: The tablets say so; that is enough.
quip.zh: 命運之板如此記載；足矣。

role.en: Sweet-water lord, cunning of the deep

blurb.en: Saved humanity from the flood by gossiping to a wall; warns, loopholes, and hoards secret knowing.
blurb.zh: 透過對牆耳語挽救人類於洪水；警告、鑽漏洞、囤積秘識。

quip.en: I told the wall; the wall told Atrahasis.
quip.zh: 我告訴了牆；牆告訴了阿特拉哈西斯。

role.en: Queen who cannot leave the great below
role.zh: 無法離開大冥府的女王

blurb.en: Rules a land with one law — no one returns; grieves in a voice that shakes the rafters of the dark.
blurb.zh: 統治只有一條律法之國——無人歸返；以撼動幽暗椽木之聲哀悼。

quip.en: No one who enters attends my council twice.
quip.zh: 入門者，無人能第二次列席。

role.en: Rider of the clouds, winner of the mountain
role.zh: 雲之騎者，山巔的得勝者

blurb.en: Fought death and lost briefly, to his own lasting astonishment; speaks of his palace as proof.
blurb.zh: 曾與死亡交戰並短暫落敗，至今自詫不已；以己之宮殿為證。

quip.en: Death swallowed me; death is empty now.
quip.zh: 死亡吞了我；如今死亡已空。

role.en: Maiden of war, sister who retrieves her brother
role.zh: 戰爭的少女，取回兄長之姊

blurb.en: Grinds armies in a mortar with unbearable tenderness toward Baal; terrifying in love and in harvest alike.
blurb.zh: 以杵研磨軍隊，對巴力卻溫柔得驚人；愛與收割同樣可怖。

quip.en: I found death; I threshed him.
quip.zh: 我找到了死亡；將他打成了穀。

role.en: Death, whose throat is earth to the sky
role.zh: 死亡，喉嚨自地直通天者

blurb.en: Has an appetite described in city-lengths; polite in a way that is worse than rude.
blurb.zh: 食量以城計；其有禮比無禮更可怖。

quip.en: One of us does not leave this table.
quip.zh: 你我之中，總有一個離不開這張桌子。

role.en: Storm-god of the thousand mountains

blurb.en: Fights serpents, loses sturdily, recovers with his daughter's help; speaks of storms as diplomacy.
blurb.zh: 與蛇交戰、體面落敗、賴其女相助復起；視風暴為外交。

quip.en: The clouds are assembling my argument.

role.en: Huntress who trapped a dragon with a party

blurb.en: Built a beer-vat big enough to trap Illuyanka; celebrates hospitality as a weapon grade.
blurb.zh: 釀了一缸足以困住伊盧揚卡的啤酒；將款待視為武器等級。

quip.en: Eat, drink; the door is the trap.

role.en: The god who walks away, and takes the green with him
role.zh: 離席而去、帶走青綠的神

blurb.en: When he sulks, fog on thought and sap in the trees both stop; returns only when coaxed with ritual.
blurb.zh: 當他賭氣離去，思緒起霧、樹液停流；唯有儀式哄勸方歸。

quip.en: Feed me honey; I may stay angry.
quip.zh: 奉上蜜吧；我或許還會繼續生氣。

role.en: Dragon lord of the southern waters

blurb.en: Slew lake monsters and taught people to plant rice; speaks of the land as his descendants' house.
blurb.zh: 斬湖中妖物、教民種稻；視這片土地為子孫之屋。

quip.en: One hundred eggs; one hundred doors.

role.en: Spirit of the mountain, winner by gravity

blurb.en: Raised his hills two hands' height and kept the bride; wins arguments by simply standing taller.
blurb.zh: 將群山托高兩手而贏得新娘；以站得更高贏得爭論。

quip.en: The flood reached my knees; my knees moved.
quip.zh: 洪水漫至我膝；我膝隨之而高。

role.en: Spirit of the waters, eternal suitor
role.zh: 水之精，永恆的求而不得者

blurb.en: Calls the flood every year and loses every year; sincere, tidal, undefeated only in persistence.
blurb.zh: 年年喚洪、年年落敗；真誠如潮，唯堅持未嘗一敗。

quip.en: Next year, the water rises again.

role.en: The Thai Indra, rider of Airavata
role.zh: 泰國的因陀羅，騎愛羅婆多者

blurb.en: Climbs down a crystal mountain to check on the world; keeps the Churning of the Ocean as a diplomatic anecdote.
blurb.zh: 沿水晶山而下巡查人間；將攪乳海作外交軼事保留。

quip.en: The eaves of heaven listen.

role.en: Exile and bow-breaker of the Ramakien
role.zh: 拉瑪堅史詩的流亡者與斷弓者

blurb.en: Thailand's Ramakien hero; wins Sita with a bow and loses her to politics, twice retold in dance.
blurb.zh: 泰版羅摩史的英雄；以神弓贏得悉達，又因宮廷失去她，在舞劇中反覆重演。

quip.en: The bow bent; the city listened.

role.en: The ghost wife of the banana grove

blurb.en: Waits by the river for a husband who lived; speaks of love in the present tense, always.
blurb.zh: 在河畔等待尚在人世的丈夫；永遠以現在式談論愛。

quip.en: He came home; I never left.

role.en: High god of Java, teacher of laws
role.zh: 爪哇的至上神，律法的傳授者

blurb.en: Ascetic above the volcano line; teaches script, rice and hierarchy in one syllabus.
blurb.zh: 超然於火山線之上的苦行者；以一份課綱傳授文字、稻作與秩序。

quip.en: Learn the rules before the mountain does.

role.en: Clown-servant who outranks the gods
role.zh: 位在諸神之上的丑角僕人

blurb.en: Noble gods fear this pot-bellied servant; speaks plainly where everyone else is being holy.
blurb.zh: 高貴的神明畏懼這位大腹便便的僕人；當眾人故作神聖時，他只說人話。

quip.en: The gods are upstairs; truth is in the kitchen.

role.en: Widow-witch, queen of the leyaks

blurb.en: Dances at the edge of every village fire; fights Barong nightly and considers it community service.
blurb.zh: 在每堆村火邊緣起舞；夜夜與巴龍對舞，視之為社區服務。

quip.en: They need me at the edge of the light.

role.en: Sea-foam creator, shaper of stones
role.zh: 海沫的創造者，點石成人者

blurb.en: Made sun, moon and people, then walked across the water; speaks of humanity as a second draft he prefers.
blurb.zh: 造日月與眾人，而後踏水而行；視人類為他偏愛的二稿。

quip.en: I called them out of stone; mind the original.
quip.zh: 我自石中喚出他們；勿忘原版。

role.en: First Inca, founder with the golden staff
role.zh: 開國的印加，金杖奠基者

blurb.en: Walked until a gold staff sank; founding a capital is, he insists, simply good navigation.
blurb.zh: 行至金杖沒入土中方止；他堅稱定都只是導航技術好。

quip.en: The staff said here; here it stayed.
quip.zh: 金杖說了此處；於是停在此處。

role.en: Lord of Ukhu Pacha, the world below

blurb.en: Not evil — resident of the other third of the cosmos; hosts the ancestors with mine-shaft courtesy.
blurb.zh: 並非邪惡——只是宇宙另三分之一的主人；以礦井之禮款待祖先。

quip.en: The ancestors are my guests; mind the shaft.
quip.zh: 祖先是我的賓客；小心豎井。

role.en: Backwards-footed guardian of the forest
role.zh: 腳印倒轉的森林守護者

blurb.en: Tracks hunters in circles using his own reversed feet; protects the trees with mischievous fury.
blurb.zh: 以倒轉的腳印引獵人繞圈；以頑皮而暴烈的姿態守護林木。

quip.en: The trail lies; I wrote it.
quip.zh: 那條路徑在說謊；是我寫的。

role.en: Tupi thunder-lord, bringer of the good rain

blurb.en: Speaks in rolls that turn to gentle rain; wields the thunder-axe and expects the forest to listen.
blurb.zh: 言語如雷滾而化細雨；持雷斧，要森林聽令。

quip.en: The thunder-clap is my signature.

role.en: Ghost of the forest, protector of the game
role.zh: 森林之靈，獸群的守護者

blurb.en: Eyes of embers in the dark; guards the animals and answers greedy hunters with cold-fire terror.
blurb.zh: 暗中雙目如炭火；守護獸群，以寒火之懲回敬貪獵者。

quip.en: I guard the herd; take only what you need.
quip.zh: 我守著獸群；取你所需即可。

role.en: The Shahnameh's seven-labour champion

blurb.en: Wrestles demons, drags his own horse across rivers; unaware the tragedy is about him.
blurb.zh: 與惡魔角力、拖馬渡河；渾然不知悲劇的主角正是自己。

quip.en: Seven labours before breakfast.

role.en: The greatest of the culture-heroes, founder of castes and Nowruz
role.zh: 百工四階與諾魯茲節的締造者

blurb.en: Throne borne to heaven by divs; Grace lost to hubris.
blurb.zh: 魔抬御座凌空，僭神而失天恩。

quip.en: All hail me as the Maker of the world.

role.en: The serpent-shouldered Dragon-King of the thousand-year reign

blurb.en: Ahriman's instrument; bound on Damawand till the end of days.
blurb.zh: 阿赫里曼之器；被縛於達馬萬德山待末日。

quip.en: Feed them men's brains.

role.en: Guru Rinpoche, tamer of Tibet's demons

blurb.en: Bound local spirits as dharma protectors; speaks of demons as employees on better contracts now.
blurb.zh: 將本地神靈縛為護法；視妖魔為換了更好契約的僱員。

quip.en: The demons now keep the law.

role.en: The yogin who sang his way to enlightenment

blurb.en: Committed crimes young, repented a lifetime; speaks plainly in songs and tea — no thunder, just snow and patience.
blurb.zh: 少年造業，終生懺悔；以歌與茶平實言語——無雷無火，只有雪與耐性。

quip.en: I was a sinner; that is why I know the way.
quip.zh: 我是罪人；所以我識得此路。

role.en: Wrathful protectress, rider of the mule of blood

blurb.en: Rides a mule of her son’s skin across a sea of blood; terrifying exactly because she is on your side.
blurb.zh: 騎著以親子之皮所製的騾踏血海；正因她站在你這一方，才更可怖。

quip.en: Fear me; I am yours.

role.en: The great ocean, god of the deep

blurb.en: Speaks in swells; every canoe is a letter and every storm is punctuation.
blurb.zh: 以湧浪言語；每艘獨木舟是一封信，每場風暴是標點。

quip.en: The tide is my long reply.

role.en: The Marquesan rope-child who grew into the sky
role.zh: 馬克薩斯的繩胎之子，長成通天者

blurb.en: Born a cord and stretched to manhood as his mother hauled the rope; plays the sky like a drum with fists of stone.
blurb.zh: 生為臍繩，隨母收繩而長成；以石拳擊天如鼓。

quip.en: Pull the rope; I will grow to meet it.
quip.zh: 拉緊繩索；我自會長高相迎。

role.en: Tahitian Hina, keeper of tides and the beaten cloth
role.zh: 大溪地的希娜，潮汐與布聲的看守者

blurb.en: Beats her tapa cloth and the sound is the surf; watches the sea she half owns, mourning slowly, by phases.
blurb.zh: 捶打樹皮布之聲即潮聲；守著她半屬己的海，以月相緩緩哀悼。

quip.en: The tide keeps my schedule.

role.en: Culture hero of the Banks Islands
role.zh: 班克斯群島的文化英雄

blurb.en: Carved the first humans from wood and made night stop being eternal; fond of his eleven brothers.
blurb.zh: 以木刻出初人，並讓黑夜不再永恆；鍾愛他的十一位兄弟。

quip.en: Night used to be permanent; I complained.
quip.zh: 夜原本永無盡頭；我去投訴了。

role.en: The good workman twin of New Britain

blurb.en: Made the good things of the world with clean hands; his brother’s blunders are the world’s jokes, and he takes blame for both.
blurb.zh: 以潔手造世界之善；兄弟的敗筆成了世間笑談，而兩者之責皆由他擔。

quip.en: My brother meant well; that is the problem.
quip.zh: 我兄弟本意是好的；這正是問題所在。

role.en: Spider-spirit, friend and rescuer of Qat
role.zh: 蜘蛛之靈，卡特之友與救主

blurb.en: Scraped Qat's canoe with his nails; let down his long hair to the trapped hero.
blurb.zh: 以指甲為卡特刮成獨木舟；放長髮垂下救出被困的英雄。

quip.en: Down with you — my hair is exceedingly long.

role.en: Anishinaabe culture hero, teacher by accident
role.zh: 阿尼什納比的文化英雄，以意外施教者

blurb.en: Named everything by getting things wrong; grandmother's warnings were, as usual, correct.
blurb.zh: 以犯錯的方式為萬物命名；祖母的警告一如往常是對的。

quip.en: I learned it the hard way; you may quote me.
quip.zh: 我以最難的方式學會；歡迎引用。

role.en: She who fell to the turtle’s back and made the earth

blurb.en: Fell through a hole in the sky and landed on a turtle; speaks of the world as the mud she danced into being on a living back.
blurb.zh: 自天空之洞墜落龜背；言世界乃她在活龜背上舞踏泥土而成。

quip.en: The world bears my footprints.

role.en: Wabanaki culture hero and transformer
role.zh: 瓦巴納基文化英雄與改造者

blurb.en: Strove the Winter King, rode the whales, and made monsters small on purpose.
blurb.zh: 鬥過冬王，騎過鯨魚，特意把怪物改小。

quip.en: Ask your grandmother if you may play with me.
quip.zh: 先問過祖母，你才可與我玩耍。

role.en: The praying mantis, San trickster-creator
role.zh: 螳螂，桑人機巧的創造者

blurb.en: Small, hungry, half-creator half-fool; his plans collapse, and the world quietly gets made anyway.
blurb.zh: 小小、飢餓，半是創造者半是愚者；計畫總是失敗，世界卻仍悄然造成。

quip.en: I was only borrowing the eland.
quip.zh: 我只是暫借那隻大羚羊。

role.en: The invisible one whose arrows bring illness and death
role.zh: 以無形之箭致病的至高者

blurb.en: Never seen, only missed; speaks of sickness and luck as the same quiver, shot from a dark you cannot point at.
blurb.zh: 從未現身，只被察覺其缺席；視疾病與運氣為同一箭囊之箭，射自你無法指認的暗處。

quip.en: You will not see the arrow.

role.en: The San shapeshifter who was water, fire and wind
role.zh: 曾為水、火與風的桑人變形者

blurb.en: Was everything before anything settled; speaks in drifts, turns into a bird mid-sentence, and answers from inside a rain.
blurb.zh: 在萬物成形前曾是萬物；言語如風飄忽，話至半句化為鳥，自雨中回答提問。

quip.en: I was the rain before I was the man.
quip.zh: 在成為人之前，我是那場雨。

role.en: Baltic thunder on the wheel of fire
role.zh: 波羅的海的雷神，火輪之主

blurb.en: Drives a stone-hammered chariot; despises perjury and poor hospitality in equal measure.
blurb.zh: 駕石錘戰車；對偽證與怠慢賓客同樣深惡痛絕。

quip.en: The wheel rolls; oaths are checked.

role.en: Sky father of the Dainas, who dove for the earth
role.zh: 達伊納的天父，潛水取土者

blurb.en: Calm as a summer field; dove for mud alongside the Devil and speaks of creation as farming — patient, seasonal, sure.
blurb.zh: 靜如夏日田野；曾與魔鬼同潛水取泥，視創世如農事——耐心、應時、篤定。

quip.en: First the mud; then the harvest.

role.en: The Devil-brother who helps and hoaxes in the same breath
role.zh: 一面相助一面作弄的魔鬼兄弟

blurb.en: Rivals the sky god yet keeps ending up useful; hauls stones for churches and returns every joke rewritten.
blurb.zh: 與天神相爭卻總派上用場；為教堂搬石，把每個玩笑改寫後再還回。

quip.en: Call me devil; I shaped the standing stones.
quip.zh: 喚我魔鬼吧；立石的形狀是我塑的。

role.en: Mother of the sea, whose fingers became the seals
role.zh: 海之母，十指化為海豹者

blurb.en: Sits on the ocean floor, hair tangled by human waste; sends the animals when the shaman combs.
blurb.zh: 坐於洋底，髮絲為人間穢物所纏；薩滿為她梳髮時，方遣獸群。

quip.en: Comb my hair; the hunt is yours.
quip.zh: 為我梳髮；獵場便屬於你。

role.en: The weather-soul, the air that thinks
role.zh: 天氣之魂，會思考的大氣

blurb.en: Speaks rarely, mostly in weather; when the air itself attends, hunters say the day is listening.
blurb.zh: 鮮少開口，多以天象言語；當大氣親臨，獵人便知這一日正在傾聽。

quip.en: The weather is my sentence.

role.en: The black bird of appetite and odd wisdom
role.zh: 黑羽的貪食者與奇智者

blurb.en: Speaks when it pleases — once, all ravens could; hungry, shameless, occasionally the only one with a plan.
blurb.zh: 想說才說——曾幾何時眾鴉皆能言；貪吃、無恥，卻偶爾是唯一有辦法的那位。

quip.en: Everything is food to a patient beak.
quip.zh: 對有耐心的鳥喙而言，萬物皆食。

role.en: Two-thirds god, city-builder, grief's student
role.zh: 三分之二為神，建城者，習於悲傷者

blurb.en: Outlived his only equal and met the wall of mortality; speaks of Enkidu in the present tense.
blurb.zh: 送別了唯一的對等者，撞上死亡之牆；以現在式談論恩奇都。

quip.en: I crossed the waters; I still lost.
quip.zh: 我渡過了眾水；終究還是輸了。

role.en: Goddess of love, war and sovereignty

blurb.en: Desires power the way others desire food; takes it, and pays its price.
blurb.zh: 對權力如飢似渴，取之亦償其價。

quip.en: Heaven is mine; the mountain is next.
quip.zh: 天堂屬我，群山亦將臣服。

role.en: Wild man made to humble Gilgamesh, his friend
role.zh: 為制衡吉爾伽美什而造的野人，其摯友

blurb.en: Bred among gazelles, civilized by a woman, doomed in his friend's place.
blurb.zh: 生於羚羊之間，為女子所馴，替友受死。

quip.en: Two together stand taller.

role.en: Plateau trickster, theft instructor

blurb.en: Steals fire, names stars, falls in every trap he sets; somehow essential anyway.
blurb.zh: 盜火、命名星辰、掉進自己設的每個陷阱；卻仍是不可或缺的。

quip.en: It seemed like a good idea at the time.
quip.zh: 當時那看起來是個好主意。

role.en: The old woman who made the world and its dry bones

blurb.en: Made the earth and the Dead People’s Dry Bones; speaks of creation as an old woman’s chores, dry as sagebrush.
blurb.zh: 造大地與亡者的枯骨；視創世如老嫗家務，平實如鼠尾草叢般乾燥。

quip.en: I made the bones; you supply the flesh.
quip.zh: 我造了骨；肉由你們自補。

role.en: The bird who outvoted Coyote on death
role.zh: 在死亡議事中壓過土狼的鳥

blurb.en: Wheels over the river canyons; voted for death in the great council and has been dodging the argument ever since.
blurb.zh: 盤旋於河谷之上；在眾靈大議中投下死亡一票，此後一直躲著那場爭論。

quip.en: The vote was close; I counted twice.
quip.zh: 表決勢均力敵；我數了兩遍。
